title: Vec::<String>::new() turbofish is non-idiomatic
description: "removed": Vec::<String>::new() uses a turbofish where the type is fully inferrable from context (serde_json serializes any Vec<String> to a JSON array). Either json!([]) or Vec::new() with the type inferred is idiomatic Rust. The turbofish is not wrong but reads as if the type is otherwise ambiguous, which it is not.
